items: Heavy Duty Plant Support Stakes & Rings​ - Made with 4.2mm thickened steel, this 3-leg support (10"W x 17"H, 3-Pack) provides unwavering plant stem support​ and cradles the heaviest peony blooms without breakage. Far stronger and more versatile than flimsy single-stake plant supports.

Stem-Safe for Indoor & Outdoor Plants​ - The rubber-coated, rust-proof steel frame lasts for seasons. Soft rubber sleeves on the ring provide a gentle, non-slip grip, protecting monstera aerial roots​ and delicate stems from damage, making them ideal as plant supports for indoor plants​ and outdoor gardens.

Versatile for Climbing & Top Heavy Plants - Indoor & Outdoor Support​ - The perfect monstera plant support, peony cage, or climbing plant support. This adjustable plant support​ ring also secures pothos, dahlias, roses, and other top-heavy flowers​ in garden beds or potted plants.

Tool-Free, Adjustable Garden Stakes​ - Requires no assembly. Just slide the legs to adjust height and spread, then press into soil for instant plant support structures. The collapsible tripod stores flat, making these garden stakes for plants​ easy to use and store indoors or out.

The Complete Indoor & Outdoor Plant Support System​ - With a discreet mint-green finish that disappears among foliage, provides reliable plant support​ for balcony gardens, patio pots, raised beds, and greenhouses. It’s the versatile, all-in-one plant support​ solution your indoor and outdoor plants​ need.
